mainEntity.name: How do I make a UGC ad with an AI actor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upload a product photo or paste its link, choose an AI actor, and add your message. Then generate the ad and download it in minutes.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to make an AI UGC ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a monthly or yearly plan based on the credits you expect to use. Each plan shows its price and included credits, and the cost of each photo or video appears before you start.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the finished ads for a client?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can use the finished ads in client campaigns. Use product photos, voices, and other material you have permission to use.

mainEntity.name: Why are AI UGC ads effective?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI UGC ads get attention because they look like the creator posts people already watch. Open with a clear problem, then show your product solving it.

mainEntity.name: Can I make a testimonial-style ad for TikTok?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose a vertical format and an AI actor to make a TikTok-style product ad. Check TikTok’s labeling rules before posting.

mainEntity.name: Can I turn a product link into a UGC ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Paste your public product link to start an ad from its photos and details. Choose an actor and make a video in minutes.

mainEntity.name: Can I make the same ad in another language?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Change the script and choose a matching voice to make an ad for another language. You can reuse the same product photo.

mainEntity.name: Can I make another version of an ad later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Start from the same product photo, change the script or scene, and render a new version. You see the credit cost before each run.

mainEntity.name: What does AI UGC mean for a product ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI UGC is a creator-style product video made with an AI actor and voice. You can make one from a product photo without filming or hiring a creator.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the ad after it is generated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Change the script, actor, voice, or captions and make another version. You can test fresh openings without another shoot.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI UGC ad take?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI UGC ad usually takes a few minutes. Add a product link, choose an actor, and download the finished video without arranging a shoot.

mainEntity.name: Should I use an AI actor or hire a person?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use AI actors when you need several ads quickly or want to reach buyers in different languages. Hire people when a real personal endorsement matters.

mainEntity.name: Will Meta accept an AI-generated product ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI-generated product ads can run on Meta when they meet its ad policies. Check your claims and any required AI labels before posting.

mainEntity.name: Can an AI actor use a voice we already recorded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Upload a voice sample you own or have permission to use. Your AI actor can speak your ad in that voice.

mainEntity.name: Do these AI UGC ads need a signed release?

acceptedAnswer.text: No signed release is needed for our AI actors, and the download is cleared for commercial use without a watermark. Use only product photos and audio you have rights to.

mainEntity.name: Can I post creator-style ads without hiring anyone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use your product photo or link with an AI actor to make a creator-style ad. You can download it in minutes without booking anyone.

mainEntity.name: How is a customer video different from AI UGC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer videos are filmed by real people; AI UGC uses generated actors and voices. It gives your ads a creator-style look without organizing a shoot.

mainEntity.name: What should a small shop look for in an AI UGC tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for simple photo-to-video steps, realistic actors, and commercial downloads without a watermark. Check the credit cost before making each ad.

h1: Make AI UGC Ads in a Few Minutes
lead: AI UGC is a casual review or unboxing ad, made with an AI actor, a script, and a realistic voice. It stands in for hired influencers, so you save time and money. Skip the creator and the shoot. Paste a product link, upload a photo, or type one line, and get a realistic, high-converting ad in a few minutes.

moreSections.h2: Create Your Product Video from Start to Finish
moreSections.lead: Bring your product photos, key selling points and script into one workspace. Choose a scene and an AI presenter where needed, then set the supported language and video format. Adapt the message for a product launch, a feature explanation or an offer, and preview the generated result before downloading.

items.d: Upload clear product photos as visual references for generation. Decide whether to focus on the full product, its packaging or a particular detail. Compare the result with your original photos, since generated details can vary.
items.t: Use Product Photos to Guide the Video

items.d: Choose an AI presenter and review the voice profile included with that presenter. Select a supported language and write the message for the audience you want to reach, so the product introduction fits the market you are addressing.
items.t: Choose a Presenter and Supported Language

items.d: Describe the speaking style and product details you want to emphasize in your brief. Use a direct script for a feature explanation or a conversational script for a lifestyle introduction. Your instructions guide the generated performance.
items.t: Guide the Tone of the Presentation

items.d: Write an opening that makes the subject clear, explain the main product benefit, and end with the next step you want viewers to take. Update the script when product details or offers change, then generate a version for that campaign.
items.t: Adapt the Script to Each Campaign

items.d: When captions are available for the selected video, choose a caption style and review the text and timing. Captions keep product names and key points visible on screen, giving viewers another way to follow the message when browsing with sound off.
items.t: Add Captions to Support the Message

items.d: Watch the generated clips and any captions together to see how the product, dialogue and story work as a whole. Once you are satisfied with the result, download the video and prepare it for the product page or social channel you plan to use.
